pictureInPictureSizeDescription: Used for landscape and square videos. Presets follow the actual ratio; Custom uses the entered size.
pictureInPicturePortraitSizeDescription: Used when video height exceeds width. Presets follow the portrait ratio; Custom uses the entered size.
pictureInPicturePositionDescription: Choose a corner for window PiP or reuse its last moved position.
pictureInPictureMonitorDescription: Choose where window PiP appears. A disconnected display falls back to the current display.
pipNoVideo: No video was found on the current page.
pipNotReady: The video is not ready for Picture in Picture yet.
pipDisabled: This video does not allow Picture in Picture.
pipUnsupported: Picture in Picture is not supported on this page.
pipFailed: Picture in Picture could not be started.
